article.story: Northwestern (6-4) at Minnesota (5-5), Nov. 21 at 12 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Northwestern by 3. Against the spread: Northwestern 6-4, Minnesota 6-4. How to watch: Fox Sports 1 Key stats Northwestern Offense Overall: 406.9 yards per game (44th in FBS) Passing: 230.4 yards per game (63rd) Rushing: 176.5 yards per game (44th) Scoring: 29.8 points per game (52nd) Northwestern Defense Overall: 365.8 yards per game (75th in FBS) Passing: 214.6 yards per game (74th) Rushing: 151.2 yards per game (85th) Scoring: 20.2 points per game (32nd) Minnesota Offense Overall: 299.4 yards per game (133rd in FBS) Passing: 206.6 yards per game (92nd) Rushing: 92.8 yards per game (135th) Scoring: 23.6 points per game (98th) Minnesota Defense Overall: 325.7 yards per game (33rd in FBS) Passing: 185.6 yards per game (28th) Rushing: 140.1 yards per game (63rd) Scoring: 24.0 points per game (63rd) Minnesota is 12th in FBS in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert on 31.1% of third downs. Northwestern is 4th in the FBS with a +14 turnover margin. Both teams have strong red zone offenses. Northwestern is 4th in FBS, scoring on 95.0% of red zone trips. Minnesota's red zone offense ranks 10th at 93.9%. Team leaders Northwestern Passing: Aidan Chiles, 1,898 yards, 13 TDs, 1 INT, 68.8 completion percentage Rushing: Caleb Komolafe, 697 yards on 122 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Griffin Wilde, 843 yards on 52 catches, 5 TDs Minnesota Passing: Drake Lindsey, 1,982 yards, 13 TDs, 7 INTs, 60.1 completion percentage Rushing: TJ Thomas Jr., 413 yards on 73 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Javon Tracy, 536 yards on 55 catches, 3 TDs Last game Northwestern fell to Ohio State 28-19 on Nov. 14. Nicco Marchiol threw for 225 yards on 18-of-31 attempts (58.1%) with one touchdown and no interceptions. He also carried the ball 10 times for -15 yards and one rushing touchdown. Komolafe had 54 rushing yards on 11 carries, adding one reception for 12 yards. Luke Dehnicke put up 88 yards on five catches with one touchdown. Minnesota fell 42-14 to Penn State on Nov. 14. Lindsey threw for 185 yards on 16-of-30 attempts (53.3%) with two touchdowns and no interceptions. Darius Taylor carried the ball 13 times for 32 yards, adding four receptions for 85 yards. Tracy recorded 51 yards on six catches with two touchdowns. Next game Northwestern hosts Illinois on Nov. 28. Minnesota plays at Wisconsin on Nov. 27.
